primary_source_review.meaning: Reviewed upstream source identity, distinct from the installed OpenMM 8.6.1 qualification. State restoration is partial; checkpoints depend on model/platform/environment; no general runtime clone follows.

contract.independent_live_engine_input: Public source-copy contract is applied before optimization, for standalone or composite engine input. Existing adapters reject unsupported copying.
contract.explicit_output: Cannot bypass source detachment; no requested file is created on refusal.
contract.engine_in_place: Explicit request retains source model/platform and returns None; no rollback guarantee on an intentional edit failure.
contract.State: Existing registered snapshot form; copying remains unsupported, with a meaningful diagnostic and captured fields unchanged.

guards.engine_fixture: Bundled alanine dipeptide plus a current marker parameter; Reference live inputs with nondefault velocity/time/step/current box and seeded constrained integrator.
failure_snapshot_fields: serialized State (positions, velocities, box, time, step, globals, integrator parameters)
guards.partial_State_copy_cases: With positions and energy-only; both preserve serialized fields on rejection.

notebook_preservation.tutorial: Seven actual code cells demonstrate retained native modes, unchanged Reference source after refusal, and explicit Reference in-place editing.

limitations: Unsupported engine copies are rejected safely, not newly implemented.
Snapshot/checkpoint comparisons are test evidence on the same live Reference context, not a portable copy or all-platform guarantee.
Explicit in-place backend failures do not acquire a rollback promise.
Other documented model/preparation/observable limitations and #583/#584/#589 remain separate.
Local overlapping source suites do not constitute hosted, installed/platform or release qualification.
